d:
The Delhi High Court has put a stay on JNU's decision to terminate Congress MP and professor Angomcha Bimol Akoijam. The university had decided to sack him following sexual harassment complaints filed by 11 female students. Justice Anup J Bhambhani issued the interim order while hearing Akoijam's petition challenging the university's decision.
The court's order temporarily puts the termination on hold, offering relief to the professor.
The matter will be heard again in January, while the allegations against Akoijam remain subject to legal proceedings.
